fusions.name: Skirting Pop
fusions.desc: A quick shot that deals 4 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Startling Crack
fusions.desc: Deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Behind the Baseboard
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you at 30% of the usual rate and you move 15% faster; the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Dark Corner
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
